# Lathe verify: running and driving the workbench

How to start the workbench app, check that it is healthy, drive each surface and clean up (#C66SW086). One Testbench workbench app in the repo serves development, Show paths and browser tests; what it must contain is on [verify-workbench](verify-workbench.md). No code exists yet; this page is the intended operation, and the dogfooder edits it when a command here fails. Commands are bash, run from the repo root `lathephp/lathe`. Back to [spec](spec.md).

## Launch
Prerequisites: PHP 8.4, Composer, Node 22.12 or newer, pnpm.
1. `composer install` and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`.
2. `pnpm build` once (and after changes under `resources/js` or `packages/*`). It writes `dist/` with a manifest; `lathe:doctor` fails without it ([spec-cli](spec-cli.md#doctor)). The Heartbeat plugin has its own bundle: `pnpm -C workbench/lathe-components/Heartbeat build`; without it `lathe:doctor` fails on the plugin manifest and the Heartbeat page has no script. Run `eval "$(mise env -s bash)"` first so node, pnpm and php are on PATH.
3. `composer serve`. The script runs `testbench workbench:build`, then `testbench serve` on `http://127.0.0.1:8000` and one `testbench queue:work` worker in the same terminal (#3XG4Y5WF). `testbench.yaml` sets `workbench.start: /lathe`, `workbench.health: true` and these build steps: `create-sqlite-db`, then `migrate` with `--seed`. The seeder fills the demo store (User, Customer, Order, OrderItem, Product, Category, Tag, Post, Comment) with 10,000 orders only when no user exists, so a restart never wipes data ([spec-performance](spec-performance.md#scale-target); content: [verify-workbench](verify-workbench.md)).
4. Open `http://127.0.0.1:8000/lathe`, sign in as `admin@lathephp.com` / `password` (also `editor@lathephp.com`, `guest@lathephp.com`, same password; guest gets 403 pages): at m1 the Dashboard shows only "No widgets yet" (the Sales dashboard comes later); Orders lists 25 rows and the footer reads "Showing 1 to 25 of 10,000".
Defaults: SQLite file, `SESSION_DRIVER=file`, `QUEUE_CONNECTION=database` (#3XG4Y5WF). A git-ignored `.env` in the repo root overrides any of them.

## Health check
Read-only: no database writes, no network beyond localhost. Both lines must pass.
```
curl -sf -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/lathe/login    # 200
php vendor/bin/testbench lathe:doctor; echo "exit $?"                          # exit 0
```
`lathe:doctor` prints `OK`, `WARN` and `FAIL` lines and exits 1 only on a `FAIL`. A healthy workbench prints no `WARN`. A `FAIL` about `dist/manifest.json` means step 2 was skipped. Pest browser tests also need `pnpm exec playwright install chromium` once; if Pest reports an outdated Playwright, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (the root `package.json` pins the version the plugin needs).

## Browser surface
Pest browser tests are the automated route; `playwright-cli` is the manual one.
```
composer test:browser                        # all flows, desktop Chrome
vendor/bin/pest --browser firefox tests/Browser/OrdersTest.php
vendor/bin/pest --headed tests/Browser/OrdersTest.php
playwright-cli open http://127.0.0.1:8000/lathe/login
playwright-cli snapshot                      # refs for the two inputs
playwright-cli fill <email-ref> admin@lathephp.com
playwright-cli fill <password-ref> password --submit
playwright-cli goto http://127.0.0.1:8000/lathe/resources/orders
playwright-cli snapshot
```
Phone checks: `playwright-cli open --mobile` or `->on()->mobile()` in a Pest test. Dark mode: `playwright-cli set-color-scheme dark`. End the session with `playwright-cli close-all`.

## HTTP JSON surface
The panel needs a session and a CSRF token. Get both with a cookie jar, then call the API ([spec-cli-api](spec-cli-api.md#resource-routes)).
```
J=$(mktemp); B=http://127.0.0.1:8000/lathe
curl -s -c $J -o /dev/null $B/login
T=$(awk '$6=="XSRF-TOKEN"{print $7}' $J | python3 -c 'import sys,urllib.parse as u;print(u.unquote(sys.stdin.read().strip()))')
curl -s -b $J -c $J -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $T" -H 'Accept: application/json' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"email":"admin@lathephp.com","password":"password"}' $B/login
curl -s -b $J -H 'Accept: application/json' "$B/api/resources/orders?per_page=25"
```
The last call returns 25 rows as JSON. Without the jar the same call returns 401 JSON. A write (`POST $B/api/resources/tags` with the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header) changes workbench data; undo it with the cleanup below. The HTTP seam in tests uses `LatheTest::resource('orders')->index()` ([spec-quality-testkit](spec-quality-testkit.md)).

## CLI surface
All commands run through `php vendor/bin/testbench lathe:...`.
```
php vendor/bin/testbench lathe:doctor
php vendor/bin/testbench lathe:plugins --diagnose
php vendor/bin/testbench lathe:action Archive      # writes workbench/app/Lathe/Actions/Archive.php
php vendor/bin/testbench lathe:prune               # prints five counts
```
Generators write under `workbench/app`; check with `git status --short workbench`.

## Seed the scale target
The 10-million-row table lives in Lathe's own MySQL lane, never in dev-mysql84: the container lathe-mysql84 (MySQL 8.4, `--memory=3g`, `innodb_buffer_pool_size` 2 GB; the 4 GB pool is only for m3's rented calibration server). Database `lathe_test_bench` holds the snapshot; never point a test run at it (the test case drops the tables of the database it runs on). As of m2 (2026-10-14):
```
bash scripts/lanes.sh up mysql
eval "$(bash scripts/lanes.sh env mysql)" && export DB_DATABASE=lathe_test_bench
php vendor/bin/testbench migrate:fresh --force
timeout 1800 php -d memory_limit=2G vendor/bin/testbench lathe:demo-seed --orders=10000000   # 557.6 s on the build machine, prints its elapsed time
bash scripts/snapshot.sh ~/.local/share/lathe-bench/orders-10m.sql.zst                         # 250 MB, about 10 s, writes <file>.counts
bash scripts/timing-run.sh ~/.local/share/lathe-bench/orders-10m.sql.zst                       # restore about 390 s, whole run about 7.5 min, ends rc=0
```
- The snapshot holds the demo tables only (users, customers, categories, tags, products, orders, order_items, posts, comments); `lathe_test_bench` must already be migrated before a restore. Any change to those tables' schema in workbench/database/migrations makes the snapshot stale: re-seed and re-snapshot (about 10 minutes).
- `timing-run.sh` restores, checks the counts and SUM(total_cents) against `<snapshot>.counts`, warms the buffer pool, runs `pest --group=budget` (B1, B1 Show path with EXPLAIN checks, B3) on the snapshot, then `node scripts/bench-browser.mjs` (B5, B6). The browser budgets serve the SQLite workbench: testbench.yaml pins the served app to SQLite, so `testbench serve` cannot read the MySQL snapshot (a cache table error on login).
- Results go to `$LATHE_BENCH_RESULTS/$LATHE_BENCH_RUN.json` (default a temp folder); the m2 numbers are the mem fact "m2 final Mac mini timing run".
- The 10M footer check: the served SQLite workbench has 10,000 orders; add one order to see "10,000+".

## Cleanup
- Stop the server with Ctrl+C in the `composer serve` terminal; if it runs in the background, `kill $(lsof -ti:8000)`.
- Data: `php vendor/bin/testbench migrate:fresh --seed` restores the default store; `php vendor/bin/testbench workbench:drop-sqlite-db` deletes the SQLite file; for MySQL, `DROP DATABASE lathe_scale`.
- Files: `git status --short` lists generated files; `git clean -fd workbench/app/Lathe` and `git checkout -- workbench` remove them. Exports and uploads live in the git-ignored `workbench/storage`; `php vendor/bin/testbench workbench:purge-skeleton` clears the skeleton's `.env` and published assets.
- Browser: `playwright-cli close-all`; `rm "$J"` for the cookie jar; remove the root `.env` if you made one.

## m1-skeleton walk (dogfooded 2026-10-13)
Launch: `eval "$(mise env -s bash)"`, both builds, then `setsid composer serve > serve.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &` (keep the pid). The server answers 200 on `/lathe/login` within 5 seconds on an empty database. Then `php vendor/bin/testbench lathe:cache` and `lathe:doctor` (27 OK, 0 WARN, exit 0). `composer serve` leaves `workbench/storage` untracked in `git status`; that is expected.
Pages and routes: `/lathe/login`, `/lathe` (Dashboard), `/lathe/resources/orders?page=&per_page=` (25, 50 or 100), `/lathe/plugins/heartbeat` (five rows and a Ping button; toast "Heartbeat OK" goes away after about 4 s), `GET /lathe/api/resources/orders`, `GET /lathe/api/plugins/heartbeat/status`. Panel pages return 302 to `/lathe/login` signed out; the JSON API returns 401.
Driving with `playwright-cli` under a fresh HOME: the `~/.dotfiles/bin/playwright-cli` wrapper reads `$HOME/.local/share/pnpm/bin/playwright-cli`, so with a temporary HOME call that real binary by absolute path and pass `--config ~/.config/playwright-cli/config.json` to `open`. Selectors that work: `getByLabel('Email')`, `getByLabel('Password')`, `getByRole('button',{name:'Sign in'|'Ping'|'Next'|'Toggle sidebar'})`, `getByLabel('Per page')` (a native select; use `select ... 100`), the user menu `getByRole('button',{name:'Admin User'})` then `getByRole('menuitem',{name:'Log out'})`. At 375 px the hamburger is the button `Open menu` (the `Toggle sidebar` button is hidden there).
Gotchas: (1) Orders URLs with a bad page now return 422 inside the shell (title "This page cannot be shown", reason "Narrow the filters" for page=401, "The page must be a whole number of 1 or more." for abc and 0); `per_page=-1` falls back to 25. Fixed in 3bca1c0/8e48c4a; re-walked 2026-10-13. (2) After a login the browser lands on `/lathe` (an admin opening `/lathe/login` signed in also lands on `/lathe`); a guest lands on the 403 page. (3) The first full page load logs one console error for `/favicon.ico` 404; any other console error is a real one. (4) Any 403, 404 or 422 page load logs `Failed to load resource ... <status>` in the console; that is the browser logging the status, not a script error. (5) `APP_DEBUG` is on in the workbench, so a JSON 419 or 404 carries a stack trace. (6) Tab titles ("Orders · Laravel", "Forbidden · Laravel", "Page not found · Laravel") are set by script after hydration; the served HTML `<title>` is only the app name, so read `document.title` after `networkidle` plus about 1 s, not right after `goto`. (7) A wrong-password error shows under the Email field after 1 to 2 s; read the page after a wait, or you see no error and a filled password field. (8) With `run-code`, `page.waitForURL(arrow function)` hangs; use `waitForTimeout(2500)` after the Sign in click. (9) Sidebar groups: Dashboard, then "Heartbeat" (group heading) with item "Heartbeat", then "Resources" with "Orders"; the guest 403 shell shows no sidebar entries and has a "Sign out" button and "Back to dashboard" (which leads back to the same 403). (10) The CSP header is `default-src 'self'` with a script and style nonce; no violation shows on any page. Re-walk of steps 1 to 6 on 2026-10-13 at 8e48c4a: all passed at 1280 and 375 px, no horizontal overflow at 375.
Forged writes (all as expected): POST `/lathe/login` and `/lathe/logout` without the CSRF token give 419 and leave a session signed in; GET `/lathe/logout` gives 405; POST `/lathe/api/plugins/heartbeat/status` gives 401 signed out, 419 with a session and no token, 404 with a token; POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE on the orders API give 404. Login rotates the session id.
Roles: admin and editor see 25 of 10,000 orders; `abilities.update` and `abilities.delete` are true for admin and false for editor; guest gets 403 JSON on both API routes.

## m2-find-at-scale walk (dogfooded 2026-10-13 at f838adf)
Isolated launch that never touches the main checkout: `git clone -q --no-hardlinks . $d/lathe`, `cp -a --reflink=auto <main>/vendor $d/lathe/vendor && composer dump-autoload -q` (the Testbench skeleton and its SQLite file live under `vendor/orchestra/testbench-core/laravel`, so the copy has its own database). Under `/tmp`, pnpm picks the store `/tmp/.pnpm-store` and offline install fails; pass `--store-dir ~/.local/share/pnpm/store/v11 --package-import-method copy`. After that, `pnpm build` aborts in its deps check (ERR_PNPM_ABORTED_REMOVE_MODULES_DIR_NO_TTY) because the store differs; run the builds directly instead: `vite build && tsc -b` in `packages/core` and `packages/ui`, `tsc -b` in `packages/vite-plugin`, root `./node_modules/.bin/vite build`, and `vite build` in `workbench/lathe-components/Heartbeat`. Then `php vendor/bin/testbench workbench:build` (about 1 s, 10,000 orders) and `setsid php vendor/bin/testbench serve --port=<free> &`. No queue worker is needed for the Show path. `lathe:doctor` prints one WARN (Resource discovery cache missing) until `lathe:cache`.
"10,000+": add one order with `php vendor/bin/testbench tinker --execute='$o=\Workbench\App\Models\Order::first()->replicate(); $o->number="ORD-WALK0001"; $o->save();'`; the footer then reads "Showing 1 to 25 of 10,000+" and "All records" reads "Narrow the filters to total all rows". The default order is by id descending, so the new order shows first.
Selectors (all `playwright-cli run-code`): search `getByLabel('Search orders')` (`/` focuses it; debounce about 0.5 s, wait 1.5 s); view switcher `getByLabel('View')` (a native select: Orders, Pending Orders); `getByRole('button',{name:'Filters'})` opens an inline panel with `getByLabel('Status',{exact:true})` (select), a Customer remote picker, Total `spinbutton` Min/Max, then `Apply`; `getByLabel('Group')` (select: Status ascending/descending, Placed ...); `getByRole('switch',{name:'Auto refresh'})` (on by default, key `lathe-polling:orders` in localStorage); sort by clicking `columnheader "Total"`; tab strip `getByRole('navigation',{name:'Tabs'})` with buttons All, Pending, Paid, saved tabs and `Options for <name>` (menu Rename, Delete; Delete asks "Delete <name>?"); `Save view` opens a dialog with Name (maxlength 100), Show count switch, Badge colour radios; Alt+Left/Right on a focused saved tab moves it and an aria-live line reads "Moved X to position N" (position among saved tabs). Palette: Ctrl+K, `dialog "Search"` with a combobox and option rows; Enter opens `/lathe/resources/customers/<id>` (404 page until m3); recents in localStorage `lathe-recent-searches`. Row menu: the last button of a row ("Actions for ..."); the editor has no row button on Orders at all. Posts: Filters -> `getByLabel('Trashed')` -> Only trashed -> `?trashed=only`; row menu Restore and Force Delete.
Data: per status about 2,400 to 2,560 orders; with `?group=status:desc&per_page=100&page=50` you see "Status: pending", "Subtotal Revenue..." and "Status: paid" on one page (on page 1 only "Status: shipped" shows, its subtotal is off the page).
Gotchas: (1) With Auto refresh on, the page refreshes the table every 10 s and `waitForLoadState('networkidle')` can make a run-code batch exceed 90 s; use `waitForTimeout` or turn the toggle off. (2) curl needs `-g` for `filter[...]` URLs, or it globs the brackets. (3) A curl cookie-jar helper for two users (admin, editor) makes the forged-write pass quick; the `PostPolicy` in the workbench grants restore and forceDelete to every signed-in user, so "restore without the ability" is only reachable as guest (403). (4) An unknown filter key on the page answers 200 with the banner "This link is out of date" and Reset; the JSON API answers 422 for the same key; Orders' Total filter key is `field_total_cents`, `total` is unknown. (5) Error states (q over 100 characters, page=401, sort=password) replace the toolbar with the message and a Reset button.
Results: Show path steps 1 to 7 passed at 1280 px; findings #RXDAC9HF (375 px page scroll), #RJA8ZG4C (Total filter in cents), #GY03XSJ2 (saved tab with a malformed sort is stored and then always 422), #Y5JHFZD9 (100-character saved tab name off screen at 375 px). Forged writes on saved tabs, delete and restore answered 403/404/422 as documented, never 500, never another user's tab.
Re-walk after fixes (2026-10-14 at 2ee872e), 1280 and 375 px: all passed. #RXDAC9HF: Orders, `/lathe/resources/orders/lens/pending-orders` (the lens is a path, not `?lens=`) and `?group=status:desc` keep `scrollWidth == clientWidth` at 375; the table scrolls inside `div.overflow-x-auto` (835 px of table in a 325 px box). #RJA8ZG4C: Total Min/Max take amounts (`2400` -> `filter[field_total_cents][min]=240000`, 409 rows, smallest 2404.81; `2400.50`..`2400.99` -> 240050/240099, 1 row; reopening Filters on that URL shows 2400.5). #Y5JHFZD9: a 100-character name ends in an ellipsis, `Options for <name>` sits on screen (x 218 to 242 of 375), Rename and Delete work and survive a reload. #GY03XSJ2: POST and PUT with sort `-total_cents:up` or `password` answer 422 `errors.sort`; `-total_cents` saves (201) and the tab opens sorted. Clicking saved "Paid" from `?filter[status]=cancelled&sort=-total_cents` gives `?saved_tab=<id>` and 25 paid rows; a saved Total Min view reopens after reload with 409 rows and no "View updated"; `DELETE /api/resources/posts/abc`, `PUT .../saved-tabs/abc` answer 404; `filter[customer]=abc` answers 422 on the API and the page.
More gotchas: (6) Sort by clicking the button inside the header, `getByRole('columnheader',{name:'Total'}).getByRole('button')`; clicking the `columnheader` itself lands in the cell's centre, misses the left-aligned button and does nothing. (7) A saved tab and its Options button share the accessible name prefix, so `getByRole('button',{name:'<tab>'})` hits two elements; use `[data-tab="saved:<id>"]` or `[data-tab^="saved:"][title="<name>"]` (a saved "Paid" sits beside the built-in "Paid"). (8) Inside a saved tab the Filters panel shows empty inputs; the tab's own filters still apply and any panel filter stacks on top. (9) `localStorage['lathe-polling:orders']` holds `"off"` after the Auto refresh switch is turned off; setting it to `false` does nothing. (10) An empty Save view name is stopped by the browser's `required` check, so no error text appears in the dialog.

## m3-edit-records walk (dogfooded 2026-10-14 at 0800ef1)
Isolated launch: `git worktree add --detach ~/.cache/rexa-m3/dogfood-tree <sha>`, `composer install -q`, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm build` (2 s, works under the home dir; no store trouble), `pnpm -C workbench/lathe-components/Heartbeat build`, `php vendor/bin/testbench workbench:build` (migrate --seed, 10,000 orders, about 1 s), `php vendor/bin/testbench storage:link` (without it uploaded images 404), then `setsid php vendor/bin/testbench serve --port=8031 > serve.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &` (kill with `kill $(lsof -ti:8031)`). Uploaded-image URLs are built from `APP_URL`, and the skeleton's `vendor/orchestra/testbench-core/laravel/.env` hardcodes `http://localhost:8000`; `sed -i 's#^APP_URL=.*#APP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8031#'` on that file (the worktree's own vendor) before serving, or every stored image URL points at port 8000. Remove the worktree when done: `git worktree remove --force`.
Reach and drive: Posts `/lathe/resources/posts`, Create `/posts/new` (key `c` on the list works), detail `/posts/<id>` (key `e` opens the edit page), Orders edit `/orders/<id>/edit?tab=billing|items`, Replicate `/orders/<id>/replicate`, Users edit for the avatar. Post fields: Title, Slug (follows title), Status (inline select in the list), Cover, Body (Tiptap, required) and Markdown body (with files).
Selectors (`playwright-cli run-code`): inputs by `input[name=number|status|placed_at|total_cents|quantity|price_cents]`, `select[name=status]`; tabs `#tab-tab-group-1-billing` / `#tab-tab-group-1-items` (the tab buttons have no role name "Items"); the list status cell is `tbody tr >> select[aria-label=Status]`; buttons `Update Order`, `Update & Continue Editing`, `Update User`, `Create Order`; the 409 dialog is `getByRole('dialog')` with Refresh and Override; a 500 shows a toast "Something went wrong. Please try again." with Retry. In `run-code`, `process` is not defined: write screenshots to absolute paths. A run-code that throws prints nothing after `sed -n '/Result/,/Ran/p'`; add `;/Error/,+5p`.
Without the Tiptap form (see below) the Show path is driven over HTTP: `~/.cache/rexa-m3/curl/lib.sh` style cookie jar (login, XSRF token header, `Accept: application/json`). Image into a Markdown field: GET `/api/resources/posts/field-attachment/markdown_body/draft-id`, POST `/api/resources/posts/uploads/markdown_body` with `{name,size,mime,draft_id}`, PUT the bytes (octet-stream, no JSON) to `/api/uploads/<id>/chunks/0`, POST `/api/uploads/<id>/complete`, POST `/api/resources/posts/field-attachment/markdown_body` with `{upload_id}` which answers the URL; then POST the post with `markdown_body`, `markdown_bodyDraftId` (camel-case key) and `cover` = a finished cover upload id (start it at `/api/resources/posts/uploads/cover`).
What passed: detail page renders heading, list and link and the image (naturalWidth 40) with 0 `<script` in the DOM and no dialog; `javascript:` hrefs, `onerror`, split `<scr<script>ipt>`, iframes and svg are stripped; inline Status change on the list persists after reload; `c` and `e` shortcuts; Order edit sections and Billing/Items tabs, repeater rows with move/remove, validation errors beside fields with red dots on both tabs; stale save on a User gives 409 and the dialog "This record has changed" (Override saves, then the detail page shows); avatar over 5 MB shows "File exceeds the 5 MB limit" with no request sent; a normal avatar uploads (start, chunk, complete, PUT) and saves; no horizontal overflow at 375 px on posts, post detail, order edit (both tabs), order detail, replicate, user edit.
Forged writes (all as expected): hidden or unknown fields on PUT orders and POST users (`created_at`, `customer_id`, `id`, `customer.name`, `email_verified_at`, `remember_token`, `avatar_name`) are not stored; inline PATCH on a non-inline or unknown field is 403, on a record the user may not update 403 (editor on orders/users), 404 for a missing id, 401 without a session, 419 without a token; upload attach across fields (cover to avatar, custom `/api/uploads` to avatar, editor draft to cover/avatar, another user's upload) is 422; both image fields share the 5 MB limit, so a stricter-size mismatch cannot be reached in the workbench; php content named png or php fails `complete` with 422; the field-dependencies POST changes nothing (post and order counts and updated_at identical), echoes only `patches` and `changed`, and answers 403 without the create or update ability and 401 signed out.
Gotchas: (1) `/posts/new` and `/posts/<id>/edit` are blank at 0800ef1 (console: require("react") from TiptapEditor), so the Post form cannot be driven in a browser (#X68G0CAP). (2) Saving any Order with its items 500s on SQLite (order_items.product_id NOT NULL in the repeater upsert), so the Order stale-edit dialog is only reachable on a User (or an Order with no items key over HTTP). (3) The form keeps a draft in the browser: reopening an edit page after a failed save shows the toast "Draft restored" with the earlier typed values. (4) Peek and preview have no UI in the workbench (no field is flagged for preview), the `/preview` and `/peek` API answer fields [] ([#NR3DWK3Z]). (5) `indexQuery` on Post only narrows the list for the editor; detail, edit and the inline PATCH of a draft post by id still work for the editor (the separate `detailQuery` and `editQuery` hooks exist). (6) The Order `Created` detail line shows a raw ISO string.
Re-walk after fixes (2026-10-14 at 795fd0d), 1280 and 375 px: all 8 steps passed, no findings. Launch as above with port 8032 (worktree `~/.cache/rexa-m3/rewalk-tree`); `pnpm build` takes seconds and `workbench:build` seeds 10,000 orders. The Post form now renders and is driven in the browser: `input[name=title]` (slug follows, `Ünï` becomes `uni`), cover = the first `input[type=file]` (`setInputFiles`, uploads start/chunk/complete on `/api/resources/posts/uploads/cover`), Body is required and is the Tiptap `.tiptap` div (click, then type), Markdown body is `textarea[name=markdown_body]` and its image is the `input.sr-only[type=file]` (the visible button is "Upload image"; the textarea gets `![name](http://127.0.0.1:<port>/storage/<file>)` appended). Buttons on every create form: "Create & Add Another" comes BEFORE "Create <Thing>" in DOM order, so `getByRole('button',{name:/^Create/}).first()` stays on the form; use the full name. List "Create Post" is a link (key `c` works too). Edit of an existing post (key `e` or `/posts/1/edit`) is filled. Order save works (PUT 200, items kept); Status options are pending, paid, shipped, cancelled (plus a blank). Validation: datetime-local cannot hold an invalid date, so "Placed invalid" is the empty state ("The Placed field is required."); a forged `placed_at: "not-a-date"` gives "The Placed field must be a valid date." plus a second line "The Placed field format is invalid."; quantity 0 gives "The Quantity field must be at least 1." on the Items tab (the page jumps to Billing after a failed save; both tabs show a red dot). Order list row buttons: `Preview <number>` (modal: Number, Status, Placed, Total, a View button) and `Actions for <number>` (menu Replicate, Delete); Customer menu has Replicate only. Replicating an Order prefills Placed and Total with Number empty; replicating a Customer prefills the email, so the first save answers "The Email has already been taken." until changed. Stale edit on an Order: two pages in one browser context, save one, save the other: dialog "This record has changed", Override saves (works with Update Order and Update & Continue Editing). Writes without a token or session answer 419; editor PUT or POST on orders answers 403; a bogus status answers 422 and changes nothing. Old gotchas 1 and 2 above are fixed (Post form and Order save work); gotcha 6 still holds for the Orders list (Placed column shows raw `2026-10-12T20:39:53Z`).

## Shown/hidden probe (after a class-toggle layout fix)

A fix that swaps one element for another at a breakpoint (a donut for a bar, a label for an icon) gets this probe in a real browser at each acceptance width, and at the widths either side of each breakpoint. Every element the fix shows must draw with width and height above 2 px, and every one it hides must be `display:none` (m27 R3: a stand-in bar the fix showed drew 6 px wide from 768 to 1236 px while the probe measured only the legend). Fill in `shown` and `hidden` with the fix's own selectors, open the page, then `playwright-cli run-code --filename shown-hidden.js`:

```js
async page => {
  const widths = [390, 640, 767, 768, 900, 1024, 1236, 1280, 1440];
  const shown = ['<selector the fix shows>'];
  const hidden = ['<selector the fix hides>'];
  const out = [];
  for (const width of widths) {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(250);
    out.push(await page.evaluate(([width, shown, hidden]) => {
      const bad = [];
      for (const s of shown) document.querySelectorAll(s).forEach((el, i) => {
        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (r.width <= 2 || r.height <= 2) bad.push(`${s}[${i}] shown but ${r.width.toFixed(1)}x${r.height.toFixed(1)}`);
      });
      for (const s of hidden) document.querySelectorAll(s).forEach((el, i) => {
        if (getComputedStyle(el).display !== 'none') bad.push(`${s}[${i}] should be display:none`);
      });
      const page = document.documentElement.scrollWidth > document.documentElement.clientWidth ? ' page scrolls sideways' : '';
      return `${width}: ${bad.length ? bad.join('; ') : 'ok'}${page}`;
    }, [width, shown, hidden]));
  }
  return out.join('\n');
}
```

A selector that matches nothing at a width prints nothing for it, so check the selectors match first (`document.querySelectorAll(s).length`).

## Cloud

Probed 2026-11-05 in a claude.ai cloud session (environment `workflow`, PHP 8.4.27, Node v24.22.1, composer 2.8.12; session_01AoVwjDpjX48G7DZW8BhUtd, main at f9c6fab9). No mise here: php, node and pnpm are on PATH.

How a cloud milestone meets every driver (m35-cloud-lanes): a Claude Project thread has no docker daemon, so `scripts/lanes.sh` cannot run there, and the thread runs the suite on SQLite only. The MySQL, MariaDB and Postgres lanes run as lathe's GitHub CI on the milestone: `workflow land` pushes the rebased sha to `ci/lathe-<slug>` (ref pattern `ci/lathe-*`; ci.yml runs on a push to main or `ci/**`, and on no `cloud/lathe-*` push), and land waits on that sha's ci.yml run (`mem project set land-ci ci.yml`) and pushes main only once every job passed. ci.yml's top-level `COMPOSER_ROOT_VERSION: 1.0.x-dev` installs a ci/ ref as main's alias, since acme/heartbeat and lathe/permission require lathe/lathe ^1.0. One landing costs two matrix runs, the ci/ push and then main's. ci.yml's octane job runs the Octane lane (`scripts/octane-lane.sh`) on that push too, so land waits on it as well; only the 10M-row benchmark stays on a device.

- The session runs as root, so every composer command needs `export COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1 COMPOSER_PROCESS_TIMEOUT=0` (without the first, plugins stay off and pest has no `--parallel`; without the second, `composer test` is killed at 300 s).
- The cloud's GitHub proxy answers 403 for every api.github.com zipball outside lathephp/lathe, so composer falls back to git clones (164 packages, which works), but `phpstan/phpstan` is dist-only in composer.lock. Before `composer install`, put its zip in composer's cache from a shallow fetch of the locked ref (a full clone of phpstan is 11 GB and took over 10 minutes in m35):
  ```
  read url ref < <(php -r '$l=json_decode(file_get_contents("composer.lock"),true); foreach(array_merge($l["packages"],$l["packages-dev"]) as $p) if($p["name"]==="phpstan/phpstan") echo $p["dist"]["url"]," ",$p["dist"]["reference"],"\n";')
  git init -q "$HOME/.cache/phpstan-src" && git -C "$HOME/.cache/phpstan-src" fetch -q --depth 1 https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan.git "$ref"
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/composer/files/phpstan/phpstan"
  git -C "$HOME/.cache/phpstan-src" archive --format=zip -o "$HOME/.cache/composer/files/phpstan/phpstan/$(printf %s "$url" | sha1sum | cut -c1-40).zip" FETCH_HEAD
  ```
  Then `composer install --no-interaction` (119 s warm).
- Then `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (11 s), `pnpm build` (26 s), `pnpm -C workbench/lathe-components/Heartbeat build` (2 s).
- Suite: `composer test`: pest 3485 passed, 16717 assertions, 0 failed, 9 skipped (parallel, 4 processes); vitest 198 files, 1484 tests passed; 860 s in all.
- Walk (headless): `setsid composer serve` to `GET /lathe/login` 200 (7 s, seeding about 1.7 s); `php vendor/bin/testbench lathe:doctor` exit 0 (32 OK, 1 WARN: the Resource discovery cache is missing); playwright-cli signs in as admin@lathephp.com / password and reaches the Sales dashboard; Orders shows 25 rows and the footer reads "1–25 of 10,000" (the Launch section's "Showing 1 to 25 of 10,000" is older text); stop with `kill -TERM -- -<pgid>`.
